Matlock finds himself in a legal dilemma: his client stuns the courtroom with a confession, and then, saying that government agents had persuaded her to do so, tries to recant it.
Matlock defends Paul J. Bartel, a top TV producer accused of murdering the programming chief at the top-rated network, and finds the case has more twists than most Hollywood scripts.
Ben Matlock becomes involved in a mob blackmail scheme when he defends a famous criminal lawyer, David O’Malley, accused of murdering an underworld kingpin.

Matlock must pull out all the stops to keep his client, David O’Malley, a famed criminal lawyer in his own right, in line, and the jury on his side. Meanwhile, Conrad races against time to track down an informer that will crack the case.
A nurse is accused of murder.

Dozing off into the nostalgic world of the 1930s, Matlock dreams he’s a washed-up, hard-drinking lawyer defending a nightclub owner accused of shooting a saxophone player named Slick, guest star Jeff Conaway.
When an Assistant District Attorney is murdered, Matlock is asked to switch sides and act as Special Prosecutor for the state of Georgia.
Matlock’s investigation as the state’s Special Prosecutor uncovers a judicial conspiracy involving two judges and a corporate lawyer.
Convinced that his brother was framed for murder, a psychopath is determined to get even and holds Matlock’s associates hostage.
Matlock’s faith in his ability as a top-notch attorney is completely eroded when he’s dismissed by a client and replaced by a younger lawyer.
During his fishing trip, Matlock encounters the small, unfriendly town of Lone Pine as he attempts to solve the mysterious death of a young farmhand and uncover a town-wide cover-up.
Albeit with some reluctance, Ben Matlock defends one of Atlanta’s most successful madams, Ann Rawls, when she is accused of murdering one of her working girls.

Disagreeable London-based American businessman Albert Gordon is shot dead. His son Eric is the prime suspect. Believing Eric's innocent, sister Laura plans a mock trial hoping to uncover new evidence. Ben travels to London to defend Eric.
Matlock discovers he has more than enough suspects to go around for a murder which has the wrong man in jail.
What begins as a simple  home burglary evolves into a very strange series of events for professional thief Kevin Gilliam.
A picturesque thoroughbred horse farm provides an unusual setting for murder when Ben Matlock defends a slow-witted stable hand, Tommy Jenks, accused of killing the stable owner’s daughter.

One of Ben’s old clients is charged with bank robbery, again. The only witness is a precocious twelve-year-old boy who presents more than a handful of problems for Matlock. One of them is the boy’s fee for helping out. He wants Matlock to defend his dad.

Phelps falls in love with a woman that the IMF has been assigned to bring out of an iron curtain country over the seemingly insurmountable obstacles set in their way by the country's secret police in the "Decoy"
An electronically guarded prison confronts the Impossible Missions Force when it tries to free a political prisoner (Richard Garland) from an escape-proof glass cell.
Elizabeth Ashley guest stars as a beautiful IMF agent who becomes the key to determining if enemy agent Nicholai Varsi is telling the truth when he claims he's defecting to the United States.
The IMF goes to the aid of a friendly South American government which has been overthrown by revolutionaries.

Barney poses as a prospective rock-music recording artist to get evidence linking an organized crime figurehead played by guest star William Windom to the sudden death of a beautiful recording star who was being blackmailed by the syndicate.

The IMF finds itself only a second away from eternity when they intercept a nitroglycerine expert who plans to blow up the government house of a small country, thus provoking war with its neighbor nation.

The Impossible Missions Force must end the murderous career of a bacteriologist working for the enemy, who has succeeded in developing a mutant strain of a deadly bacteria which could be used as a practical battlefield weapon.

A dog that collects rare stamps -- on command from the IMF -- figures in a perilous journey to the stronghold of a narcotics kingpin (guest star Fernando Lamas) on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

Jim Phelps assumes a risky pose as a drug addict with information to sell to get behind the Iron Curtain where he seeks to stop an unknown assassin from killing an unknown victim on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

Before a statute of limitations expires on a 10-million dollar robbery, the Impossible Missions Force must spring the suspect from prison and dupe him into leading police to the hiding place of the money.
The IMF devises an elaborate scheme to dupe foreign agent James Reed into stealing a bogus missile guidance system in "The Missile"

William Shatner guest stars as Joe Conrad, a drug dealer who becomes the unwitting dupe of the Impossible Missions Force in their plan to capture the largest shipment of cocaine ever brought into the country.

The Impossible Missions Force is pitted against the ingenious logic of an enemy agent (guest Steve Ihnat) as the IMF attempts to lead the agent through a maze of complicated clues in order to reach a false conclusion.
The Impossible Missions Force is assigned to knock out a boxing syndicate which fixes fights to create favorable odds for a bookmaking operation, in the first half of a two-part story.
Barney poses as a fighter making his comeback, who boxes his way to a title bout with Staczek (Robert Phillips) in the second half of a two-part episode.
The imagination of the IMF is put to the test when a massive spy ring in the U.S. headed by fashion photographer, David Redding, threatens to cripple the country with a deadly pneumonic plague.
Guest star Fernando Lamas portrays a diplomat-playboy who romances another diplomat's wife, played by Lee Grant.
Mister Rogers tells viewers that there are many different kinds of food. Food for the eyes, for the ears, and for the spirit.

Mister Rogers shows a portrait of his father and has his portrait painted. He says no two people are exactly alike. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, King Friday gets an "exactly-like-me" portrait. It is a mirror.
Mister Rogers remembers that his parents sometimes had to say "no" to keep him safe. Then, King Friday says "yes" to officiating a wedding.

programmes.st: Mister Rogers Leans to Break Dance
programmes.d: Germaine Vaughan shows Mister Rogers how to break dance. Chrissie Thompson, who is handicapped, visits. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, Ana Platypus wants to be in the wedding but can't. Daniel is having trouble being the ring bearer.

Mister Rogers shows photographs of weddings. He goes to Brockett's Bakery to make arroz con leche. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, everyone is preparing for a wedding. Daniel is nervous about his role as ring bearer and his costume.

Mister Rogers visits a pottery studio to see how Eva Kwong makes a bowl. Later, Mister Rogers talks about weddings. Betty Okonak Templeton Jones marries James Michael Jones in the Neighborhood of Make-Believe.

programmes.st: Families: It Takes Time for Plants to Grow
programmes.d: While planting a seed, Mister Rogers talks about how long it takes for plants to grow and that learning to wait is important. He also shows a video about how people make orange juice.

Mister Rogers shows a film of a bird family, and an origami artist demonstrates how to make paper birds and puppets. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, a puppet couple, Betty and James, adopt a baby daughter.

Mister Rogers visits pediatrician Dr. Jane Breck, who shows young viewers what might happen during a child's routine checkup. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, Cousin Mary Owl plans a cousin reunion!

Mister Rogers talks about how children are curious about families that are formed by adoption and talks about his family's adoption of his own sister. He shows a film about different families in his Neighborhood.

programmes.st: Families: A Field Trip to See the Penguins
programmes.d: Mister Rogers visits Sea World to see the families of penguins there. He talks about how every person in the world is different from everybody else. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, the cousin reunion takes place.

programmes.st: Making & Creating: Many Different Ways to Play
programmes.d: Mister Rogers builds several things on the sand table and talks about different ways to play. He shows a video of some of the many ways children like to play.

programmes.st: Making & Creating: Learning to Make Chinese Dumplings
programmes.d: At Chef Brockett's bakery, Eva Kwong's grandmother makes special Chinese dumplings, and Mister Rogers talks about how children can learn about so many things from adults.

programmes.st: Making & Creating: How Wooden Rocking Horses Are Made
programmes.d: Mister Rogers shows how people make wooden rocking horses. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, Mr. Aber gets a mask that makes him look like King Friday, and the Neighbors talk about the importance of making and keeping friends.

programmes.st: Making & Creating: A Kitten Is Born
programmes.d: Mister Rogers shows viewers a kitten named Jimmy and a film of Jimmy's birth, and assures viewers that "it's all right to wonder about things." Then, poet and essayist May Sarton visits.

programmes.st: Making & Creating: Bob Leathers - Playground Designer
programmes.d: Mister Rogers invites viewers along on a visit to a special new playground designed and built by both adults and children. He makes up a song at the piano.

Mister Rogers introduces his television Neighbors to gymnast Chaney Umphrey when he visits at his gym and watches as he exercises. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, mischievous Lady Elaine Fairchilde reveals a mystery!

programmes.st: Visit a Factory to See Trikes Made
programmes.d: Mister Rogers visits a toy factory where people make plastic molded tricycles, and he receives a visit from folk singer Ella Jenkins who collects toy tops from around the world.

programmes.st: Mister Rogers Flies a Toy Plane
programmes.d: Mister Rogers flies a balsa wood airplane, and Mr. McFeely visits an airport control tower. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, Prince Tuesday discovers that learning to ride a bike isn't always easy!

Mister Rogers shows how empty containers plus some imagination can create a whole Neighborhood. In Make-Believe, Ana Platypus is jealous of Prince Tuesday's new bike and angry because her parents aren't buying one for her.

programmes.st: Visit to a Toy Lending Library
programmes.d: Mister Rogers visits a toy lending library and sees children playing with different kinds of toys. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, Prince Tuesday learns to ride his bike, and also learns to share it!

programmes.st: Things to Do Inside When It Rains
programmes.d: Mister Rogers arrives with a raincoat and talks about things to do inside. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, Lady Aberlin dances in the rain. X flies to slide down a rainbow. Daniel wants to learn Tai Chi to stop his scary dreams.

Mister Rogers hangs a fish mobile, then goes to see some killer whales swim and play. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, Lady Elaine teaches dance and says males weren't invited to the studio because they don't dance.

programmes.st: Mister Rogers Watches Sam Weber Dance
programmes.d: Mister Rogers visits Sam Weber and sees him dance. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, King Friday XIII goes to Lady Elaine's dance school, and she turns him away claiming that men can't dance. Sam Weber arrives and dances.

Mister Rogers helps to weave a scarf. Henrietta Pussycat's ballet teacher, Miss Cloud, does not speak but communicates with movement. The Junior Tamburitzans perform two folk dances. Mister Rogers talks about making up stories and dances.
Mister Rogers, with the help of his ventriloquist dummy, learns that sign language and talking can be two different ways of saying the same thing.

programmes.st: Queen Sara and Mayor Maggie Switch Jobs
programmes.d: Mister Rogers shows a video of children's television programs from around the world. Queen Sara Saturday and Mayor Maggie prepare for their job switch. Nancy Caterpillar is anxious to transition into being a butterfly.

programmes.st: Mister Rogers Talks About Alike and Different
programmes.d: Mister Rogers arrives with a dog. Bob Trow stops by with the Bob Dog costume. Prince Tuesday fears that the change will be permanent. Neighbor Aber arrives to explain that the switch is just temporary.

Mister Rogers arrives with a clown mask. "Mayor" Sara prepares a speech as two lost clowns arrive. To help the clowns find their way to the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, Queen Sara suggests that she and Mayor Maggie trade jobs.
Americans insert more than 3.5 million coins into vending machines every 15 minutes; how vending machines work; visiting a factory that produces high-tech vending machines; giant gumball machine.

Cutting, digging, picking, stripping, shaking, and raking--whatever the crop, there's a custom machine to harvest it; it all began with handpicking, and today it's often one man and one machine harvesting hundreds of acres in a single day.
Unearthing the many murky mysteries of the soil; plunging into the muck that paved the way for groundbreaking innovations.

The world's best extreme athletes, designers, manufacturers, and engineers explain and demonstrate why the gadgets, gear, and technology of these sports have captured the public's imagination and revolutionized the sporting industry.

programmes.st: Building a Skyscraper: The Human Environment
programmes.d: In hour three of our crash course on mega-skyscraper construction, we learn about the human element and development of systems that make us comfortable.

Fertilizer--without it two thirds of the world would starve. It makes our lawns grow greener and our crops grow taller; take a tour of the places where the essential nutrients that feed the soil are harnessed.

A historic survey of adaptation to killer environmental conditions travels to the desert, Arctic, sea, jungle and space, charting the body's physiological responses to extreme circumstances such as frostbite, heatstroke and hypothermia.

Paint spans Impressionist canvases to Space Shuttles, customized hot rods to Golden Gate Bridge; this ubiquitous product protects ships from corrosion, Stealth Bombers from radar detection, and surfaces from wear while adding color to life.
Freight trains helped build America, see how they are built, organized, and monitored.

The Supermarine Spitfire, designed by R.J. Mitchell in 1935, proved revolutionary against German opponents and helped turn WWII's tide during the Battle of Britain; interviews with surviving aces reveal the courage that halted Hitler's advance.

More than 50 years after its construction, the Golden Gate remains one of the world's great engineering marvels. It took 25-million man-hours and 80,000 miles of cable to complete; the cost in human life proved even greater.

The Massachusetts Central Artery/Tunnel Project, a.k.a. The Big Dig, is an impressive municipal construction project in U.S.; its objective to replace Boston's decaying highway infrastructure with 160 new highway miles.
The transmission of forces from point to point through fluid opens the door for the Industrial Revolution.

Well over two million years before modern man evolved, his primitive ancestors were making tools; the ability to extend the hand and strengthen the arm is considered one of the keys to human evolution.

DDA Hobbs (KATHE MAZUR) gets involved in a case concerning the suspicious death of a customs agent. Provenza avoids discussing a sensitive issue with Raydor. Guest stars abound.
In a case that hits a little too close to home for Rusty, a 19-year-old prostitute is brutally murdered.
The team works strategically to capture a serial killer who has put everyone on high alert. Trying to solve the case quickly, Raydor is torn between two seemingly right decisions.
After a bad batch of drugs claims the lives of two brothers in high school, the race is on to find the dealer. Rusty feels smothered by his new around-the-clock security detail.
The squad tries to find a newly released prisoner who has missed two parole meetings. Therapist Dr. Joe Bowman (BILL BROCHTRUP) evaluates Rusty over a game of chess.
When a body turns up at a posh country club, the squad's investigation leads them down a money trail full of surprises. DDA Rios' actions have Rusty questioning her intentions.
Christmas vacation is interrupted when a baseball scout is found dead, and a complicated kidnapping scheme unfolds. Rusty opens up to Dr. Joe (BILL BROCHTRUP) about his mom.
Major Crimes works with the FBI, including Fritz Howard (JON TENNEY), on a case. It is revealed how each member of the unit became interested in joining the police force.
The squad investigates a bomb explosion. Rusty dons a bulletproof vest in an attempt to catch the person responsible for threatening him. MALCOLM-JAMAL WARNER guest stars.
Gibbs and the team are called in on a weekend when a Navy Lt. Commander in charge of a shipment of nuclear weapons is apparently abducted.
When the wives of two Marines are murdered, Gibbs and the team are called in to investigate. Gibbs and the team fear the murders are racially motivated since the two women are Asian.
The NCIS team is shocked when they discover the severed head of a Marine at an illegal automotive chop shop run by Marines.
The team investigates the mysterious explosion of an ambulance that is supposedly carrying the remains of a Marine killed in a car crash.
Gibbs and the team are called to investigate when a group of teens on a nature hike discover Marine dog tags in a national forest.
Gibbs and the team are called in when a teenage student at a Quantico base high school attaches a bomb to his body and holds his fellow students hostage.

Gibbs and the team are called in when a couple of kids stumble upon the body of a missing Marine in a frozen lake. As the team searches the frozen lakebed for clues, they come across three more bullet-ridden bodies.

Gibbs and the team are called in when a Pentagon cryptographer suspected of spying apparently commits suicide. With their prime suspect dead, the NCIS team must uncover whether or not she was the Pentagon's mole.

Doug and Carrie want to conceive but receive another negative pregnancy result. When it is revealed that Carrie only has one working ovary, they find that they must get started in conceiving right away, only to be hindered when Doug's parents visit.
Carrie grows jealous when Spence's girlfriend recruits Doug to test her culinary work. Meanwhile, Arthur's lack of classical movie knowledge shocks Carrie.
Now that Deacon and Kelly have separated, Doug makes it his mission to get his friend out of the funk he's been in by taking him out to the clubs.
Doug and Carrie find an old wedding gift.

Al and Peggy delay going to a closing of their favorite hamburger joint, Johnny Be Good's, when Bud and Kelly need them to solve their own problems. Meanwhile, Steve and Marcy prepare a party for their bosses at home.
Al is reluctant to have Buck neutered despite being threatened with lawsuits from numerous neighbors regarding Buck's "nocturnal carnal activities.”
The Bundys take a vacation to near-beautiful Dumpwater, Florida and stay in a cut-rate motel where an ax murderer that hates tourists shows up every five years since 1967.
After a hair-raising encounter with the maniac, Al decides to get the family out of town. But, they are trapped at the motel by a storm and the locals are unwilling to help them.
John walks into the diner and sees Chris, Bob, and Jake standing around a booth.
Chris' ex-husband, Roger, is in town and comes to the diner to see her.
The fire marshal threatens to fine Chris for a faulty sprinkler system at the diner, but Chris flirts her way out of it.
John has a dream that he and Chris kissed each other. At the office, Linda is late and tells Margaret it's because her cab got hit by a runaway hotdog cart.
Joe and Helen have to explain how they torched Brian's house. An insurance investigatoris suspicious of the whole scenario.
Joe and Helen learn to deal with their "overly neighborly" neighbors.
Joe and Helen find themselves celebrating their first year anniversary at a "SinglesMingle."
The suicide hotline proves to be good for Antonio. Helen competes with a gourmet foodcart
An argument over a traffic ticket gets Bill committed to a mental hospital.
The staff is asked to comfort a comatose Jimmy following his heart attack.
As Matthew reveals he's a virgin, Bill and Lisa struggle to keep their new program on the air.
Dave is forced to apologize for his comments in a magazine interview.
Adam is determined to figure out what Andi's hiding when he discovers she's been keeping secrets from him for his own good.
Adam is thrilled and honored to help Joe buy a new car but is caught off guard when Joe suddenly becomes irritable, and the negotiations go off track.
When Adam and Don realize they need to bring in more business, they film a commercial advertising their company.
Adam and Andi set up Adam's boss on a date to boost her spirits in the hope that she'll then be in the mood to have Adam resume work on the mini-mall.
While Doug and Carrie are on vacation with friends, Arthur calls Doug to say there's a mold problem in the basement that will cost $ 7,000 to fix.
Doug and Carrie have to pay $12,000 for the mold problem and Doug reluctantly asks his father for financial support.
Carrie gets mad at Doug for not asking about her job evaluation and at that the fact that he never thinks of her because he is too busy planning his Super Bowl party.
Doug and Carrie hire Steve and his group of Russian mold employees to repair their damage, but it takes much longer and costs more than they expected.
Becker has an extra ticket to Chicago and Reggie decides to go.
A friend of and an old friend of Beckers is in town.
Dr. John Becker gets shot and Frances Fisher guest stars as his doctor. (TV-PG)
Frances Fisher guest stars again as Dr. Elizabeth Carson and reveals to Becker her attraction to him
Becker and Liz realize that they have a wacky relationship because they both snoop through each other's stuff and Bob wins and loses to lottery tickets.

programmes.st: Target: Mafia: The Kennedys And The Mob
programmes.d: Account of Joe Kennedy's business dealings with mob bosses like Frank Costello, and the role of the Mafia in the rise of John Kennedy's political power.

Veterinarian Valerie McDaniel and her boyfriend Leon Jacob look like they have it all. But in February 2014, Houston police receive a tip that a murder-for-hire plot is in the works and a woman's life may be in danger.
Jack and Linda Jones, a Florida couple, seemed to have the perfect life--until Jack turned up dead.
DC Layton investigates the case of a man who is alleged to have assaulted a taxi driver.
A blood-soaked man walks out of a hotel lift shouting that he has killed someone.
A British woman is found dead after a date, and a girl is killed to cover up an inappropriate relationship.
A mysterious meeting ends with a woman's body found on a country lane. A mother is dead after a house fire.
A Montana town is stunned when building contractor Larry Streeter is murdered by Teddy Ernst, a popular wheelchair-racing champ.

programmes.st: Pittsburgh: Til Death Do Us Part
programmes.d: A church-going man's second wife dies the same way his first wife did, in a drowning accident at home. Was it coincidence...or murder? Paul Winfield narrates.
A probe into the mysterious death of artist Ana Mendieta, who plunged from her 34th-floor apartment in New York City in 1985.

In December 1986, a young college student was found murdered off a remote highway overpass in San Diego. The thought of a killer roaming the freeways of Southern California's sun-drenched urban paradise had female drivers in the area wrought with fear.
In an instant it was over. 49-year-old Larry Volk was shot in the head as he fixed his car in the hot Nevada sun.
In 1987, Atlanta socialite Lita McClinton was murdered by a hitman. Her estranged millionaire husband, Jim Sullivan, was convicted 19 years later.
A beauty queen's murder shocks Australia; police hunt down John Travers and his gang, bringing them to justice.

On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home.  The killer left few clues.  It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere.  But the FBI refused to give up.

Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps.  When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.
When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry.  But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.
When a sadistic murderer surfaces in Scotland, terrified local authorities call on a Chicago detective who investigated a killing spree with the same horrific pattern five years earlier.

Captain Archer and his crew set out to gain information about the mysterious and antagonistic Xindi race.
Enterprise starts experiencing effects of the spatial distortions pervading the Delphic Expanse and falls victim to predatory aliens.
On a mission to investigate an abandoned Xindi vessel on a jungle planet, Archer, Reed and Hoshi succumb to a virus that mutates them into a primal life form.
The NX-01 gets closer to a showdown with the Xindi when Captain Archer takes on an enigmatic passenger: a beautiful slave named Rajiin.
When Enterprise responds to a distress call from a Vulcan ship stranded in the Delphic Expanse, Archer and his boarding team are attacked by insane zombie-like Vulcans.
A powerful telepath makes contact with Hoshi and offers to help Enterprise find the Xindi... for a price.
Archer, Reed and Major Hayes infiltrate a Xindi-Sloth industrial colony to learn more about the weapon of mass destruction that will be used against Earth.
A spatial distortion leaves Archer unable to form any new long-term memories. Years in the future, he wakes up one morning and is stunned to learn the outcome of the human-Xindi conflict.
When a settlement of humans living a 19th-century Western lifestyle is discovered on a Delphic Expanse planet, Archer and crew set out to learn how they got there.
When Trip suffers a catastrophic injury, his only hope for survival is a transplant from a "mimetic simbiote" which Phlox grows from one of his exotic creatures.
Archer and T'Pol travel back in time to 2004 Detroit to stop a Xindi plot.
Religious zealots hijack Enterprise to use it as a weapon against the enemies of their faith.
An Andorian ship led by Commander Shran arrives in the Delphic Expanse to help Enterprise hone in on the Xindi superweapon.
Archer finds himself face-to-face with Degra, the designer of the Xindi superweapon, and tries to trick him into revealing its location.
As Archer tries to unravel the mystery of a rescued alien, long-simmering feelings explode among his senior officers.
The fate of Enterprise is in Dr. Phlox's hands as the rest of the crew must be induced into a coma in order to survive a trans-dimensional disturbance.

programmes.st: Up the Long Ladder (aka "Send In the Clones")
programmes.d: When Starfleet receives an Earth-like distress signal from deep in space, the Enterprise is sent to investigate.

The Enterprise is transporting delegates to a diplomatic conference dealing with Federation membership. Counselor Troi is more than just a bit embarrassed when her mother Lwaxanna, as outrageous as ever, arrives on board the Enterprise.
The Enterprise is ordered to proceed to an emergency Rendez-Vous to collect a special envoy who is traveling from Starbase 153 to meet them.
The crew of the Enterprise participates in war games.

Riker returns from an away team mission wounded and infected with microbes from the planet below. He is soon in a coma in sick bay, the microbes having fused itself to his sciatic nerve and impeding his normal functions.
The Enterprise is carrying an eminent scientist, Dr. Paul Stubbs, to the site of a binary star where they are expecting a massive stellar explosion to occur in a few hours.
After a century of silence, the Enterprise receives a message from the Sheliac system informing them that they have discovered a human colony on a world in their sector.
The Enterprise responds to a distress call from Rana IV, a Federation colony that is under attack from an unknown alien ship.
A proto-Vulcan culture worships Captain Picard and prepares to offer Counselor Troi as a sacrifice.
A startling surprise awaits the crew of the Enterprise when a mission costs the life of a crew member, who left her son behind.

The Enterprise picks up ancient radio signal code from the ruined planet Aurelius 9, remnants of the total war over 1,000 years ago between Mentaurs and Promelians which caused both races' extinction.
LaForge gets left behind on a storm-plagued planet when the rest of his team encounters a Romulan warrior.
While the Enterprise hosts negotiations for control of a stable wormhole, Troi forms a personal relationship with an opposing negotiator, unaware of his true being.
The Enterprise pursues a race of "gatherers" who continue to raid Federation outposts, unaware of the dangers lurking among them.
When a Romulan officer defects to the Federation with a warning of an impending invasion, Capt. Picard struggles to decide if he is to be believed.
Investigating a planet applying for membership into the Federation, the crew of the Enterprise finds a group of inhabitants who used to be soldiers but now fight for their very existence.
While visiting a planet under civil war, Dr. Crusher is taken hostage by an opposing faction of the planet's ruling government.
A malfunction in Seven's cortical node threatens to destroy her.
Tom and B'Elanna's relationship could be the loser when Tom enters a race.
Tuvok's investigation of a series of mysterious attacks aboard Voyager leads him to a most unlikely suspect: himself.
The Doctor is forced to work on an alien ship where patients' care is determined by their social status instead of medical need.
Starfleet Lt. Barclay's hologram convinces Janeway to pursue a dangerous, untested plan to bring Voyager home.
The Doctor experiences physical sensations for the first time after Seven downloads his matrix into her body.
With Voyager under repair, Harry seizes a chance to prove himself as a commander but finds that being a starship captain is more than he bargained for.
The Doctor is torn between his duty to Voyager and his conscience when warrior holograms rebel against their Hirogen creators.
The Doctor questions his decision to join the rebel holograms after they kidnap B'Elanna and kill two innocent organics.
Voyager encounters an energy field which leaves each section – and its crew – existing in a different time period.
B'Elanna is strangely disturbed by her unborn child's Klingon traits.
The issue of capital punishment divides the crew when Voyager agrees to transport condemned prisoners to their deaths.
A group of Klingons separated from the rest of their race believes B'Elanna's unborn child is the Savior foretold in their sacred scrolls.
Voyager is sucked into an inescapable subspace void which is inhabited only by other trapped vessels battling each other for survival.
The Voyager crew has been abducted and brainwashed to serve as workers in a severely short-handed industrial alien society.
To save Janeway and the rest of Voyager's crew, Chakotay must convince her that her seemingly happy life as a worker on Quarra is not real.
Seven's attempt to explore her human side distracts her from her duties and puts Voyager at risk.

The Atlantis long-range sensors detect the signal of a subspace tracking device familiar to Dr. McKay. The team follows to signal to a damaged hive ship drifting in space. Amidst the ship’s records, they discover references to a secret Wraith base.

When an alarm sounds, McKay suspects that a highly infectious disease has triggered the city’s self-protection system. With vital systems affected, the Atlantis team finds themselves trapped in various sections of the city with no way out.

Wanting to maintain diplomatic relations, Sheppard and McKay accompany Harmony, a precocious young princess, on a mandatory rite of passage. However, they are unaware that she has enemies, and character flaws, yet to be dealt with.

When Lt. Colonel John Sheppard receives word that his father has passed away he returns to Earth. But once there, he becomes embroiled in a dangerous experiment gone awry—a human form Replicator now on the loose that must be recaptured at all cost.

During an off-world mission in a village rocked by fierce tremors, Col. Samantha Carter, Dr. McKay, and Dr. Keller become trapped when they fall into a sinkhole. But every attempt to escape the confines of the chamber puts them in further jeopardy.

With the Destiny still out of power, a plan is born to abandon the ship using the last working shuttle, in hopes that another planet will be habitable. But hope is short-lived when the only way to determine who will go and who will stay is a lottery.

Despite severe rationing and around-the-clock security, the water reserves onboard the Destiny continue to drop. Dr. Nicholas Rush has no explanation for this latest setback but, if they are to survive, they must find a new water source soon.

With the situation onboard the Destiny dire, General O’Neill (Richard Dean Anderson) and Homeworld Command order Col. Young to execute a high-risk plan concocted by the IOA scientists which, in theory, could return the crew to Earth.

After making a surprising discovery on a jungle planet, members of the team become ill. In an attempt to isolate the infection, the team sets up camp in the jungle. But when night falls, the illness will be the least of their worries.

O'Neill (Richard Dean Anderson) attempts to stop a massive Goa'uld invasion of Earth. But to call off the attack, the Goa'uld lords demand the destruction of the Stargate. O'Neill doesn't fully trust them - but the fate of Earth lies in the balance.

A mysterious tablet discovered on a distant planet infects anyone who touches it with a hallucinogen. The remarkable stone infects Teal'c and, before long, the entire team except Hammond. Can Hammond (Don S. Davis) stop it and save SG-1 alone?

As part of an exchange program with the planet Orban, O'Neill travels to Earth with a girl who possesses incredible technical knowledge. But by the time O'Neill discovers the truth behind the child's superior mind…it may be too late for them all.

Alternate reality versions of Carter (Amanda Tapping) and Kawalsky (Jay Acovone) are found in Area 51. Brought to Stargate Command, they start to deteriorate. However, return to their own reality means death, as their world was invaded by Goa'uld!

SG-1 is captured by Aris Boch, a bounty hunter chasing an evil Goa'uld named Kel'tar. He offers them freedom in exchange for their help. They agree, only to find that Kel'tar is, in fact, a Tok'ra, whose capture would endanger countless others.

On another one of their quests, SG-1 encounters a medieval civilization and frees a woman tied to a stake as a sacrifice to a demon. When the woman is freed, the demon vows to destroy the village unless the SG-1 team is offered up in appeasement.

SG-1 lands in the middle of a blazing battle between some Stargate soldiers and a Jaffa army. Believing the soldiers to be the missing-in-action SG-11 team, O'Neill and the others provide assistance… until the mystery team turns its weapons on SG-1!

During a rescue of captured Abydonians, Daniel finds his missing wife, Sha're. But instead of greeting him, she attacks him - leading to her death at the hands of Teal'c. Distraught over her death and angry at Teal'c, Daniel quits Stargate Command.

Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs.  Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella.  Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey.  Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez.  Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway.  When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract.  The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programmes.st: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programmes.d: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo.  Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby.  They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home.  Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room.  Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met.  In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story.  Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programmes.st: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programmes.d: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room.  They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programmes.st: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programmes.d: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company.  Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programmes.st: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programmes.d: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house.  Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programmes.st: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programmes.d: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house.  While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job.  His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird.  He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

Tip Corey, the son of a man allegedly murdered in North Fork, has a killer's reputation and comes to town to kill Micah.

Lucas and Mark stop on the way to the county fair to deliver a message to Micah, who is escorting a prisoner to be hanged. Mark and Lucas recognize the prisoner.
Mark and Milly are shocked when Lucas begins gambling. They don't know that Lucas is "undercover" trying to catch a man cheating.
Mark befriends singer-banjoist Lafayette Bly, a blind man with an acute sense of hearing and a very strong grip.
A retired lawman's irrational jealousy threatens not only to destroy his marriage but also to make him an easy target for someone who wants him dead.
No one is more surprised than Micah when newcomer Leota Carraway claims he's her long-lost husband and the father of her child.
Lucas is torn by conflicting emotions when he meets the town's new preacher, a former outlaw whom the Rifleman vowed to kill.
The town of North Fork becomes a haven for outlaws when suave Ben Judson smooth-talks his way into the marshal's job.
A handsome gambler moves into town and begins wooing Milly Scott, claiming to have known her deceased brother.
Lucas develops temporary amnesia from a head injury while visiting a strange town and mistakenly assumes the identity of a wanted criminal.
A former neighbor of the McCains' is released from jail after serving his sentence for robbery. Lucas lets the man work for him but the new hand holds a secret.
When Lucas, Mark, and Micah get lost in Old Mexico, they are held hostage by a group of bandits who intend to kill the men and take Mark as a slave.
While trapped in the ghost town saloon, Lucas tries to come up with a plan to escape with his son and Micah after Mark refuses to leave without him.
Lou Mallory arrives in North Fork and starts buying up land and businesses. Lou and Lucas start disliking each other after she reveals plans to build a railroad on "worthless" land.
When a woman arrives in North Fork with symptoms of smallpox, Lucas, Lou Mallory, Doctor Burrage, and hotel occupants are quarantined in the hotel with an outlaw.
Gunslinger Johnny Drako rides into town and tells the bartender that he is looking for Lucas McCain. After Johnny leaves the saloon, Sweeney hurries to tell Lucas.
A man arrives in North Fork, intending to marry Lou Mallory. The hotel owner looks for a way out from marrying the man to whom her dying father promised her.
An assassination plot unfolds as four gunmen disguised as cavalrymen enter North Fork. Their target: Sen. Jim Borden. Their weapon: a Gatling gun.
Sharpshooter Marty Blair tries to persuade Lucas to buy Mark a rifle. After Lucas shoots a man during a robbery at the hotel, Mark and Lucas disagree with his character.
Fast-draw artist Wade Randall is in town, bragging of his gun battles with notorious bad men until one of them shows up to challenge his story.
When Lucas refuses to sell his land, Mr. Prescott will stop at nothing to  change his mind. He hires men to try to persuade Lucas, but he refuses.
Mark's careless actions cause the death of a friend. Unable to accept the truth, he blames the rifle and runs away from home. Soon, he is faced with a tough decision.
Nils Swenson takes the marshal's place for a few days while Micah is away. To maintain peace, Nils insists that anyone coming into town must turn in their weapons.
Lucas's self-confidence begins to slip away when he misses an easy shot that could have cost Mark his life.
A murder occurs at a railroad camp and a young Indian friend of Lucas is accused of the killing. When Lucas tries to help the boy, he finds himself on trial.
Lucas and Mark come upon Winslow Quince, a peddler whose wagon has broken down. They help him bring his wagon to North Fork for repair.
Gridley Mau, the son of a man Lucas killed during an attempted robbery, comes to North Fork looking for revenge.
The first railroad train is coming to the new North Fork station. Onboard is a Japanese nobleman and his servant, visiting the West to learn about the United States.
At Halloween, rustlers take advantage of the seasonal disguises to raid a cattle ranch. Lucas' faith in his son's honesty is shaken when he hears rumors of Mark being mixed up with the thieves.
Mark and Lucas run into Micah on the trail and help when the prisoner he is transporting injures his arm. Lucas' life is endangered when a snake crawls into his bed.
While Mark goes hunting for Old Spike, Lucas goes hunting for his mortal enemy. Lucas is thrown into jail to stop him from murdering his former friend.
Lucas is baffled when the marshal of a neighboring town refuses to hold a gambler who just attempted murder.
The senior residents of Sunnyvale decide that the secret to youth is acting young, and in particular playing a childhood game called "kick-the-can."

The trio plants a stray cat at Furley's door, hoping he'll bend his rules and keep it. When a girl appears looking for her kitten, Furley lies and says he took it to the pound; so Jack and the girls search the pounds and bring home three different cats.

Jack and Janet are up in arms when Chrissy announces that she is leaving on an overnight business trip with her new boss.
After a happily-married computer-matched couple sells Jack on the merits of computer dating, the fun begins when Jack secretly signs up.
Jack plays cupid to his girlfriend's widowed father, but his arrows misfire when the love-starved older man makes Janet his target.

Janet is thrilled with her new job as an aerobics teacher, and her new boss Tina is thrilled with Jack. When Tina blackmails Jack into being at her beck and call, Larry offers to take her off Jack's hands.
Janet loses her cool when the groovy guy and campus Adonis of her high school shows up for a date, and Jack and Chrissy conspire to leave them alone in the apartment.

Stanley Roper invites his former tenants, Jack, Janet, and Chrissy to a surprise disco party he is planning for his wife, Helen, and asks the two girls to give him secret lessons to prepare for the event.
Janet moves in with Mrs. Roper while Mr. Roper is away on business, then stews about Jack and Chrissy being alone for the night in the trio's upstairs apartment.

When the Bistro's building inspector demands a bribe from Jack, Janet suggests that they tape the next conversation for evidence. The recording the police hear, however, is of Furley telling Jack he has the pot (terrain) he wanted.
Jack finds himself in hot water when best friends Larry's girl says she still has a mad crush on him.
Mysterious phone calls and secret meetings lead Jack, Janet, and Chrissy to believe that Helen Roper is having an illicit fling with her husband's best friend.
The roommates play a game of musical beds after Janet tells her visiting parents that she and Jack are newlyweds.
Jack and Janet face the danger of losing Chrissy to a fast-talking guru who dazzles her into believing her place is at his side - in a distant commune.
Larry devises an acid test to see if Furley's latest find is actually a gold-digger.
A letter to a lovelorn column convinces Chrissy and Janet that the other is having a love affair with Jack.

Jack and Furley get locked in a freezer together. Convinced they are going to die, they have a heart-to-heart talk, and Jack confesses that he really isn't gay. Once safe, Jack worries because Furley knows the truth about him.
Jack, Janet, and Chrissy face having to split up when Chrissy's father, Reverend Snow, announces that their special living arrangement jeopardizes his appointment as the new local minister.
To boost Jack's confidence, Terri turns on the charm, causing Janet to suspect that her new roommate's interest in Jack is more than platonic.

Jack believes he has won a baking contest that is open only to women. Disguised as "Grandma Tripper," he goes to collect the check and learns that he is a finalist and must bake his cookies for the company's executives to win the prize.
Chrissy is in hot water with landlord Stanley Roper when he eavesdrops and believes she is pregnant.

Jack agrees to be Janet's date at a stuffy, formal party. After taking an invigorating drink, he becomes the life of the party, embarrassing Janet and causing a shambles. Guest Star(s): Barry Williams

On Christmas, Eve Randall receives his most daunting assignment yet from a young boy who has eight cents to pay: bring in Santa Claus.

Following an Indian attack on their stagecoach that kills his prisoner, Randall and an eastern gentleman unaccustomed to the ways of the West must trek to safety across many long, hot miles of hostile Apache territory.
Josh escorts an East Coast photographer to take a picture of his friend El Gato (The Cat), who is a famous, hilarious bandit living in the hills of Mexico with a small army.
When Randall has a sheriff bed a prisoner, the man's gang kidnaps the sheriff and two others and threatens to kill one per day until the man is freed.
Josh is on his way to River City to transport three convicts there to be hanged.
When phony wanted posters put a price on the head of a retired Confederate officer, Colonel Sykes' daughter summons Josh Randall to help keep the bounty hunters at bay.

The cry of 'Silver!' is heard again in Monument City, a ghost mining camp once the scene of a historic silver strike.  Prospector Bat Masterson, who has an old claim, returns to Monument City to find he's road-blocked by Clay Adams and Harvey Mason.
The town of Meeker, Colorado is made frightful by the invasion of three men set upon killing one of its women. Bat Masterson interferes.
Bat Masterson is a gambler, empire-builder, Indian-fighter and journalist.  He uses his derringer and gold-headed cane to win the justice he believes to be right.
Bat Masterson is a gambler, empire-builder, Indian-fighter and journalist.  He uses his derringer and gold-headed cane to win the justice he believes to be right.

The town of Las Tables is about to hang three men - Bat Masterson finds Marshal MacWilliams' son hiding in the Las Tables graveyard - It's a much less macabre place than the town, itself, where three men are about to be hanged.
Bat Masterson is a gambler, empire-builder, Indian-fighter and journalist.  He uses his derringer and gold-headed cane to win the justice he believes to be right.
Paladin's new friend, stabbed by an assassin, makes a dying request to have his body taken back home to his hacienda in Mexico.
An Armenian winemaker hires Paladin to find his runaway daughter and break up her ill-considered romance with a cowhand.
Aaron Bell is on the warpath to bring his brother's executors to justice. Paladin is hired to protect a town from Bell.
Ben Huttner is a fugitive wanted for manslaughter. He is also the illegitimate son of a wealthy man and stands to inherit his five-million-dollar estate, but he must first come back and stand trial.
Paladin rides to the San Luis Rey church in search of a very old brandy. When he is asked by the Padre to retrieve a statue of worship, they strike a bargain where they both may get what they want.
A puppeteer gives Paladin a wagon ride to an Army fort commanded by a general with presidential aspirations.

Sheriff Eli Parsons asks Hollister to help track down three convicts, one of them an innocent man. The chase leads Hollister and Claibourne into an Indian ambush. Hollister captures one of the fugitives and is able to identify the innocent man.

Sheriff Hollister (Pat Conway) arrests pretty Anita Torreon as a receiver of loot for a holdup gang and takes her to Prescott to stand trial. But, aboard the stagecoach, disguised gunmen suddenly appear to rescue Anita and recover the loot.

Frank Callaway wins acquittal for a client and then escapes death at the hands of the two men who tried to frame his client. Sheriff Hollister captures the killer but no lawyer will accept the defense; so Callaway himself volunteers.

Julie Dixon takes a job as a dealer in Tombstone's Saloon. Here, she deals a grim hand of vengeance. Her brother Sam, an incurable gambler, had killed Julie's lover six months before. She has taken the job as part of a plan to wreak revenge on Sam.

Sentenced to hang for a holdup murder, Reed Barker meets his fate at the gallows... but when the rope breaks when the trap is sprung, he is freed under Territorial Law. Sheriff Hollister and Editor Claibourne must unravel the mystery.

Released from prison together, Jake Conroy (Lee Van Cleef) and Hobe Jones scheme to rob a rich mine owner. With the cash in their control, the thieves ride hard from Mexico with Sheriff Clay Hollister and Editor Harris Claibourne in pursuit.
A letter from a friend brings Paladin to a bar where he's drugged. He wakes up chained and in the company of a man with a similar story and a woman who's path they've both crossed before.
An ex-gunfighter, Roy Calvert, blames the people of Benedict for his wife's death. The town is in the middle of a drought and Calvert and his son are blocking the only access to water in the area.
The townspeople of Moon Ridge, Colorado believe there are monsters in the mountains. Dan Bella's daughter is taken by something and he finds strange footprints outside his daughter's window.
Mexican rancher Don Luis Ortega hires Paladin to escort his daughter across the border into the United States.
Juliet Harper is being hunted by the grandsons of Colonel Jeremiah Pike. Paladin meets her on the stage and now the Colonel is after both of them, and Paladin is without a gun.

"Love Island" continues as our cast of young singles settle into villa life and their daily routine of dating, flirting, dumping and more. The Islanders are already discovering that in paradise, you'd better be ready to expect the unexpected.

Packed with unseen action from an unforgettable first week in the Love Island villa, along with a recap of all the big stories, the best moments and much, much more. Join Iain Stirling as he reveals brand new and exclusive footage.

While life in the luxurious villa might look like fun, the Islanders are already finding out that nothing is certain in paradise. There's heartbreak on the horizon and with £50,000 up for grabs, the stakes simply couldn't be higher.

The gorgeous young things are busy enjoying their days of romance, flirting and endless fun in the sun. But they can't let their guards down because things can change quickly in paradise and nobody knows what's around the next corner.

The second week continues, and the islanders are already experiencing a summer they'll never forget. But as ever, there are plenty of twists and turns for them, and with £50,000 up for grabs for the winners, everybody's in it for the long haul.

The temperature's rising and there are plenty more surprises in store. As ever, nothing is quite what it seems in paradise. And with that cash prize of £50,000 up for grabs for the winning couple in seven weeks' time, everyone wants to couple up.

The temperature just keeps on rising in paradise. Our gorgeous young things are having an absolute blast, but some are coupling while others are in danger of being dumped. Right now - nobody wants to go home.

It's the end of week two and the islanders are having the time of their lives, but as the love games continue, no-one knows what's waiting around the next corner. And with just one couple in with a chance of winning, the battle to stay is on.

It's time for another feast of unseen moments from the villa. All the flirting, fun, romance and juiciest gossip is waiting right here, along with a recap of all the big stories and the best moments of the week.

Week three on "Love Island" is under way, and the temperature is rising yet again. For the cast of gorgeous islanders, it's already been a summer they'll never forget. But with a 50,000 pound prize awaiting our winning couple, can anyone be trusted?

It's week three on 'Love Island' and the islanders are soaking up the sunshine in their very own luxury villa. It just doesn't get better than this, but behind the flirting and romance, who's for real, and who's just playing the game?

The islanders are having the time of their lives as they flirt and frolic in the Spanish sunshine, but they all know that only one couple will have the chance of walking away with the 50,000 pound prize.

It's week three on 'Love Island' and our gorgeous guys and girls are definitely making the most of their unforgettable summer in paradise. But while the sun keeps on shining, the twists and turns just keep on coming.

With only 5 days left in the season, the swamp is blindsided by a cold front sweeping across Louisiana, bringing a punishing frigid rain. When temperatures drop, gators run for cover, and the hunters will have to chase them down.

It's down to the final 4 days and Troy's road to the crown takes an unexpected turn. A good friend and a fellow hunter passed away. When his long-time helper asks Troy to help fill their remaining tags, Troy has a dilemma.

After a hurricane tears through the bayou on opening day of Alligator Season, delaying hunting for five critical days, the swampers turn to family to help make up for lost time. Complicating matters is the arrival of two new hunters.

programmes.d: Tori, Cat, and Jade compete with each other to win the affection of Beck's big, handsome, hockey-loving Canadian friend, Moose.
Beck wants to ask a girl out but is worried about Jade's reaction, so Tori and Andre attempt to get Jade a date to even the playing field. Robbie works to remove a butterfly stuck in Cat's ear.
Mason Thornesmith's bratty 12-year-old kid wants to buy Rex from Robbie.  Meanwhile, a masked flour thrower is on the loose in Hollywood Arts.

Andre stays with Tori to work on a song for class.  They quickly find they aren't the best roommates.  Jade discovers an unflattering picture of herself on the internet, and conspires to take it down.
Sikowitz challenges the students to say yes to everything for one week.  The gang agrees, and they soon find themselves out of their respective comfort zones.
Tori is selected to be the team captain for a new game show, Brain Squeezers. She has to choose 3 teammates to compete with her and quickly becomes overwhelmed by requests from the gang.
When Tori gets invited to sing the national anthem at a televised basketball game, she worries she'll forget the lyrics, but ends up in a much more embarrassing encounter with the team's mascot.

Andre gets Tori a job at a frozen yogurt stand, but work may keep them from performing at the Hollywood Arts Cowboy Luau.  Robbie wants to ask Cat to the luau, but asks someone else, making Cat jealous.
Tori and the gang compete to see who can get the most followers on The Slap.  But when they get caught up in the competition, they neglect their schoolwork and their friendships.
Tori wins a contest to sing the opening number at a big music awards show, but the producer wants to totally change her look and behavior. Tori agrees, but finds that she doesn't like her new image.

After Tori fills in for her ailing sister in a big musical showcase, Tori is asked to enroll at an elite performing arts high school.  But once there, Tori struggles to fit in to her new surroundings.
Tori goes all out to master an iconic Hollywood Arts monologue in Sikowitz's class.  Meanwhile, André and Robbie join a ballet class to meet girls, with disastrous results.
Tori has to defend herself after Jade claims Tori hurt her in a stage fighting exercise.  Meanwhile, Trina has to fend off Robbie's advances when he thinks their stage kiss meant something.
Tori accidentally gets Beck fired from a small role in a movie, then must figure out a way to get him his job back.  Meanwhile, Robbie suffers frightening nightmares about his best friend Rex.
Tori gets the lead in a high profile school musical, but freaks out when a stage makeup project goes awry, and she's left looking like a zombie on opening night.
After a jealous Jade dumps Beck, she soon regrets it and recruits Tori to help get him back.  Meanwhile, Trina puts on a one-woman show and tells Robbie he better give it a good review… or else!
Tori struggles to find the perfect birthday gift for Trina, then decides to write her sister a song as a present.  An ungrateful Trina turns the song into cash by selling it, enraging Tori.

Tori suggests Robbie capture videos of students' everyday lives to increase his blog traffic, but when the camera is turned on Tori, she asks him to stop.  Only Robbie doesn't and Tori realizes she's created a monster.

The gang decides to hire an intern for the web series. Carly and Sam hire a guy they think is cute, but the new intern proves to be more trouble than he's worth. Freddy has to prove to Carly and Sam that they're better off without him.
The gang spends the night finishing their projects at Ridgeway during the annual school lock-in. Carly and Freddie start to suspect that Sam might have a crush on their new friend Brad.
Carly suspects that her new boyfriend, Steven, is cheating on her with Tori Vega, so the gang plans a trip to Los Angeles to catch him in the act at a party thrown by Andre at Kenan Thompson's house.
iCarly gets invited to be guests of honor at WebiCon, but when the fans start asking questions that are too personal, things quickly gets out of hand. Spencer does battle with a costumed nemesis.
Carly steps in to resolve an argument for Sam and Freddie. Soon Freddie and Sam are coming to Carly for help with every single fight. Now that she's involved, how can Carly remove herself?
Mrs. Benson discovers Sam and Freddie's relationship after Gibby, now the subject of Sam's abuse, concocts a plan to split them up. Will Carly fight for Sam and Freddie, or help Gibby break them up?

The Commonwealth of Virginia rested its case against Lorena Bobbitt who was on trial for cutting her husband John's penis off. She was pleading not guilty by reason of insanity.

During the Defense's case, John Bobbitt returned to the stand in his wife's trial. He explained the fights they had during their rocky 4-year marriage. It was just 5 days after their anniversary that Lorena cut off his penis with a kitchen knife.

John Bobbitt was defending himself on the stand, as his wife stood trial for cutting off his penis. He denied repeatedly that he beat Lorena, and instead, he claimed it was Lorena who was violent with him over the years.

programmes.t: THE GREAT WAR OF ARCHIMEDES [English Dub]
programmes.d: It is the early 1930s and the command of the Japanese Imperial Navy determines to construct the world's biggest and most formidable battleship, Yamato. One of the admirals, Yamamoto Isoroku, disagrees. He recruits the upstart and mathematics' expert Tadashi Kai who discovers there are discrepancies between the official cost estimates and the actual figures. They soon find out that they have stumbled upon a conspiracy.

programmes.t: MASTER Z: IP MAN LEGACY [English Dub]
programmes.d: Following his defeat by Master Ip, Cheung Tin Chi tries to make a life with his young son in Hong Kong, waiting tables at a bar that caters to expats. But it's not long before the mix of foreigners, money, and triad leaders draw him once again to the fight.

A famed action hero films his own film on territory claimed by other yakuza gangs, including Japan's toughest martial arts assassin, after his devastatingly quick, samurai-style fighting technique turns filmmakers against him.

Yang travels to Chen Village to learn a powerful form of Tai Chi. Though villagers are forbidden from teaching outsiders, Yang becomes their best hope for survival when a man arrives with a plan to build a railroad through the village.

Tai Chi Hero is a martial arts adventure story about a martial artist defending his adopted home and marriage while mastering the art of Tai Chi. Starring Jayden Yuan, Angelababy, Eddie Peng. Continuing his journey, Yang Lu Chan marries into the Chen family to learn advanced Tai Chi. Soon, he must overcome internal village suspicion and lead the defense against a powerful army armed with deadly western technology.

Sword Master is a martial arts action story about an elite swordsman who fakes his death to escape violence, only to be dragged back by his past. Starring Lin Gengxin, Peter Ho, Jiang Yiyan. Exhausted by endless bloodshed, a legendary master fakes his death to live in anonymity.

Distanced from his family after a car accident takes the sight of his daughter, a father must use his professional bodyguard training when a flight they're on is overtaken by armed hijackers. A taut puzzle of deception unravels when the hijackers' motivations are revealed and the father must rescue not only his daughter and wife, but all those aboard.

One day, Su-a becomes infected by a zombie virus that has swept across the globe. In a desperate bid to protect her, Jeong-hwan takes Su-a to Eunbong-ri, a seaside village where his mother, Kim Bam-sun, lives. Two scientists (Jed Brophy, Jeffrey Thomas) and a young psychic (Laura Petersen) encounter a demonic spirit at a haunted New Zealand farmhouse.

A professor investigates three chilling and inexplicable cases related to an abandoned asylum, a car accident and the spirit of an unborn child. Even scarier -- each of the macabre tales seems to have a sinister connection to his own life.
After moving into a haunted apartment, a shut-in hires a stranger to perform an exorcism.
The ghost of a teenager (Abigail Breslin) tries to protect a young girl (Eleanor Zichy) and her family from a dead serial killer (Stephen McHattie) who can possess the living.

programmes.d: Two years after escaping from a demonic terror, Alfie and Nara try to continue their lives, but Alfie is still haunted by feelings of guilt and unnatural visions.
Haunted by eerie images and unexplainable messages, a man (Nicolas Cage) tries to unravel the mystery behind the disappearance of his son.
Friends (Brandy Schaefer, Mikey Roe, Jeff Larson) encounter genuine horror during a road trip to visit haunted houses.
A young man and woman move to a small, abandoned town in Iceland and begin renovations on an old house. Little by little they learn about the town's dark history.
A serial killer brings an unsuspecting new victim on a weekend getaway to add another body to his ever-growing count. She's buying into his faux charms, and he's eagerly lusting for blood.

Jonny Baptiste is sent to live with her estranged Aunt Hildie. On her 18th birthday, she experiences a family spell that redefines her, called Forevering. When several girls go missing at school, a feral Jonny hunts the perpetrator.
A teenager visits a haunted forest and thinks a violent poltergeist has followed her home.

A morgue technician reanimates the body of a little girl, but must harvest biological materials from pregnant women to keep her breathing. When the girl's mother, a nurse, discovers her baby is alive, the two make a dark deal.
Disturbing visions and her sister's disappearance lead a woman (Caity Lotz) to call a cop (Casper Van Dien) and a psychic to her childhood home.
A woman plagued by nightmares of a serial killer learns her dreams have a horrifying connection to the real world.

After undergoing an experimental procedure to restore her damaged hearing, 20-year-old Chloe Grayden begins to suffer from auditory hallucinations seemingly related to the mysterious disappearance of her mother.

A teen and her mother live simply in a home in the woods, spending their time making metal music. A chance encounter with a fellow teen causes her to uncover a connection between her family and witchcraft, which causes a rift with her mother.

Shishigami is rattled to see Inuyashiki stand up from a blow that should have killed him before flying away. Seeing that, Inuyashiki knows that Shishigami has a robot body just like himself. After this meeting, Inuyashiki studies his abilities, and uses them to save others. Meanwhile, Shishigami confronts a group of delinquents who have been tormenting his best friend Naoyuki Ando.

When the fully tattooed yakuza criminal Samejima finds a girl he likes, he kidnaps them, drugs them up, and then roughs them up. Fumino was happy. She had a job and a fiance. But one night, Samejima sets his sights on her, and has his men kidnap her. Fumino manages to escape, and runs to her fiance Satoru's house, but Samejima is in hot pursuit. Inuyashiki comes to save them, but gets shot.

Ando is struggling with the fact that his friend Shishigami is responsible for the spree of home invasions. After reading that hospital patients were being cured, Ando theorizes that there is someone else out there with the same powers as Shishigami. Ando lures Inuyashiki by pretending to need help and asks him to stop Shishigami. Meanwhile, Shishigami learns his mother has terminal cancer.

Kaito goes up against a Syndicate-owned pool hall hustler to win back the Legendary Cue, a treasure once owned by Jii before he was cheated it out of it by the Syndicate boss many years ago. However, things look dire when Jii's pool hall is put on the line and Kaito apparently has no skill with the game.

A brilliant if arrogant teen detective comes to town, determined to capture Kid the Phantom Thief. This turns the heat up for Kaito, especially since they're classmates. In fact, Kaito becomes Suguru's rival even out of uniform, leading to a "gentlemen's bet" over which of them will go on a date with Aoko.

Kaito has a new classmate, Akako, who appears to possess genuine magic abilities, the kind that bend everyone to her will... except for Kaito and his alter ego, Kid the Phantom Thief! Who will come out on top in the inevitable showdown, sorceress or illusionist?

After a startling radio broadcast grants Mustang's forces the advantage over Central's troops, the Flame Alchemist unleashes the brutal power of burning hatred in the battle against the killer of Maes Hughes.
As Envy writhes within the firestorm unleashed by Mustang's vengeful rage, Hawkeye must take drastic measures to prevent the Flame Alchemist's hatred from burning out of control.

programmes.t: Naruto the Movie: Legend of the Stone of Gelel [English Dub]
programmes.d: Drawn into a fierce struggle over the legendary Stone of Gelel, Naruto, Shikamaru, and Sakura must keep the stone from falling into the wrong hands.
Rising from the rubble of his former base, Dr. Eggman reveals his new battleship, the Egg Fort, and attacks Station Square. Sonic faces off his nemesis once again on X-Tornado.

The President demands the search for Dr. Eggman after Sonic destroys the Egg Fort. Meanwhile, Sonic and his friends are taking a well-deserved vacation where they discover that another Chaos Emerald is nearby.

Knuckles rescues a man named Hawk from ancient ruins. Discovering later that Hawk had discovered a chaos emerald, Knuckles seeks for him once again in Oriental City. There he is confronted by some local thugs Li Yan and the Bruiser Boys.

An old man who supposedly knows the secret to Hitler's legacy lives in East Germany within the Berlin Wall. Lupin and his gang track the old man down, but the old man can't recall anything about any legacy. In order to bring back the old man's memories, Lupin and his gang decides to put on an act. Will the old man's forgotten memories come rushing back?
An international soccer game is taking place in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil and Lupin has his eyes on the box office and betting takes. Will the box office heist go as planned?

When Oga wakes up one morning, he's floating in a great pool of water... However it is actually Baby Beel's pee, as it is "urination season" right now in the Demon World. Oga is concerned about the entire city being inundated and humanity's imminent destruction, so he takes Baby Beel to the drug store to buy some disposable diapers. While he's there, a bunch of bank robbers a take Oga, Baby Beel, Hilda and Furuichi (who were chasing after him) as hostages.

On the back of Oga's fist a mark appears that is proof of his contract with the son of the Demon Lord, Beelzebub... The Zebul Spell. After hearing that the demonic power grows as well as the Zebul Spell the more he gets into fights and runs wild, Oga decides not to fight anymore to avoid that situation. However, Himekawa Tatsuya, heir to the Himekawa Zaibatsu and one of Ishiyama's TKKH like Kanzaki, is secretly plotting to do Oga in himself, and gives the command to his lackeys...

"A - Hilda brought back a bunch of toys from the Demon World for Baby Beel. When Oga and Hilda were assemble one, a horrible accident occurs! B - The Zebul Spell expands when one does evil. So won't it contract if you act like an angel? ...thinks Oga, who uses a Play Doctor toy with Beel as the doctor to try and heal patients. It's time to play Demon World Doctor!"

The crew stumble on a science centre where vile historical figures have been 'cured' of evil.
Lister, Cat and Rimmer are uploaded into mechanoid bodies and forced into slavery.

Rimmer looks for another dimension where he is not such a giant loser.

Rimmer creates his perfect companion - an identical duplicate of himself.

Holly's latest invention takes the crew into a bizarre parallel universe.
Time starts to run backwards after the boys travel through a time hole.
Red Dwarf is on a collision course towards a minefield of black holes.
A chameleonic genetic mutant which sucks out human emotions is loose aboard Red Dwarf.
Lister accidentally triggers the ship's self-destruct system.
The crew run amok through history, blithely ignoring the consequences of causality.
Kryten has 24 hours to live, so the crew decide to give him the best night of his life.

Lister's curry finds its way into the transmogrifier and assumes near-human form.
Justice World is able to inflict crime back on the perpetrator. Rimmer is in big trouble.

The crew are alarmed to receive an SOS call from themselves fifteen years into the future.

The Dwarfers encounter a real, live human woman who's attractive and nice.
The crew go on a journey of personal discovery when their generators fail.
Lister is missing Rimmer, at least until Kryten steps in to help.

Lister is impregnated with a virus and he tries to talk his way out of the problem.
The crew finally discover who stole Red Dwarf and why.
The nanobots have not only re-created Red Dwarf, they have also brought back the old crew.
Rimmer plans to move up the career ladder with help from a 'sexual magnetism virus'.
The Dwarfers face two years in the brig for crimes against the Space Corps.
Lister joins a battle-hardened convict army, trained to go on suicide missions.

Lister and Rimmer are forced to take on the guards in a basketball game.

The Dwarfers are now on probation and are trying their hardest to behave.
